name: Meditation
overview: Meditation in Scripture is portrayed as a focused and reverent engagement with God's law and presence, exemplified by Isaac who went out to meditate and pray in the field at eventide. The Psalms emphasize meditating on God's law day and night, delighting in it as a source of spiritual strength and communion with God. Joshua underscores the practical blessing of meditating on Scripture, promising prosperity and success to those who do so consistently. Ultimately, biblical meditation involves thoughtful reflection, heartfelt devotion, and a desire for God's words to shape both heart and life.
